questions.question: Seven friends, H, E, L, P, I, N and G, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Only N sits between E and L. L sits third to the left of H. I sits to the immediate left of H. P is not an immediate neighbour of L. Who sits to the immediate left of G?834
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order? ELX, DJU, ?, BFO
ECHF is related to LJOM in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GEJH is related to NLQO. To which of the given options is KINL related, following the same logic?

Town X is to the south of Town I. Town C is to the south-west of Town I. Town C is to the west of Town A. Town A is to the east of Town X. Town M is to the east of Town A. What is the position of Town C with respect to Town M?
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?58 ÷ 3 × 15 − 5 + 4 = ?

Six boxes, A, B, C, D, E and F, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. A is kept third from the bottom. Only one box is kept between A and B. Only two boxes are kept between A and D. C is kept immediately below D. E is kept immediately above B. Only one box is kept between F and D. Which box is second from the top?

This question is based on the following four words.HAW   FER    COX    GELIf in each of the words, each letter is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no vowel?

In a certain code language,
'A + B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,
'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,
'A x B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and
'A ÷ B' means ‘A is the father of B’.
How is N related to K if ‘B ÷ A – N x D ÷ G – E + K’?
If 'E' stands for '+', 'F' stands for '−', 'G' stands for '÷' and 'H' stands for '×', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 36 G 12 E 3 H 24 F 4 = ?

Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. B is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between B and G. C is kept at one of the positions below B. Only A is kept between G and F. E is kept at one of the positions above G. How many boxes are kept above G?

12 is related to 61 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 16 is related to 81. To which of the following is 17 related, following the same logic?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
In a certain code language, ‘ETCH’ is coded as ‘1469’ and ‘HEAT’ is coded as ‘6492’. What is the code for ‘A’ in that language?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:No rice is wheat.All wheat is grain.Some grains are barley.Conclusions:(I) Some rice is grain.(II) Some wheat is barley.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

This question is based on the given words.TAX          CHO           BEN            VIM       In each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter-clusters thus formed will no vowel appear?

In this question two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.Statements:I) The government has recently fixed the fees for professional courses offered by unaided institutions, which are much lower than the fees charged last year.II) The parents of the aspiring students launched a severe agitation last year protesting against the high fees charged by unaided institutions.
options: Both statements I and II are effects of independent causes.
Statement II is the cause, and statement I is its possible effect.
Statement I is the cause, and statement II is its possible effect.
Both statements I and II are independent causes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Statement II is the cause, and statement I is its possible effect.) है।
